summary.text: Cheryl Pasteur is a Democratic delegate representing District 11A in the Maryland House of Delegates and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former teacher and FBI agent, she took office in January 2023.

paragraphs.text: Cheryl Pasteur earned a B.A. in English education from the University of Maryland at College Park in 1971 and an M.S. in urban education from Morgan State University in 1975.

Her career experience includes work as a graduate cohort instructor with Morgan State University, a teacher with Baltimore County Public Schools, and an agent with the Federal Bureau of Investigation.
Ballotpedia lists Pasteur as holding the Baltimore County Public Schools District 2 office from 2019 to 2022.
She assumed office in the House of Delegates on January 11, 2023, and serves on the Judiciary Committee.
